{{Short description|French medical doctor (1934–2024)}}
'''Pierre Jean René Noël Tiollais''' (8 December 1934 – 5 August 2024) was a French [[Physician|medical doctor]] and [[biologist]].

== Life and career ==
Tiollais was born in [[Rennes]] on 8 December 1934. He was a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences|French Academy of sciences]]<ref>{{cite web|title=Académie des sciences|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-T/pierre-tiollais.html|publication-date=}}</ref> of the [[Pasteur Institute|Institute Pasteur]] and the [[Académie Nationale de Médecine|French Academy of Medicine]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Académie nationale de Médecine|url=http://www.academie-medecine.fr/composition/membres/membres-titulaires/|publication-date=}}</ref>

In 1979, in collaboration with Francis Galibert, he carried out the complete sequencing of the [[hepatitis B virus]] [[genome]], which made it possible to manufacture the first detection tests and screening for this disease.{{cn|date=January 2020}}

In 1985, with his collaborators at the Institute Pasteur, he created a [[vaccine]] obtained by [[genetic engineering]] (recombinant vaccine) against [[hepatitis B]], prepared on [[Chinese hamster ovary cell|Chinese hamster ovary cells]] (CHO) .<ref>''L'Histoire des vaccinations'', Hervé Bazin</ref> His team were the first to create the hepatitis B vaccine using CHO cells. In 1990, he received the research prize from the Allianz-Institut de France Foundation.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.allianz.fr/v_1391122800000/qui-est-allianz/allianz-s-engage/dans-la-societe/la-recherche-medicale/media/a_PlaqALZPrixRecherche2013.pdf |title=Allianz s’engage depuis 30 ans dans la recherche médicale |access-date=2019-12-13 |archive-date=2016-08-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160817121646/https://www.allianz.fr/v_1391122800000/qui-est-allianz/allianz-s-engage/dans-la-societe/la-recherche-medicale/media/a_PlaqALZPrixRecherche2013.pdf |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Tiollais died on 5 August 2024, at the age of 89.<ref>{{cite web |title=Remembering Pierre Tiollais, professor at the Pasteur Institut, Head of the Molecular Biology of Viral Infections and Cancer Unit |url=https://franceintheus.org/spip.php?article11547 |website=France in the United States |access-date=13 October 2024 |date=11 September 2024}}</ref>
